facts.fact: Finance SAO reports a BCEAO communique of 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions in WAEMU to integrate with PI-SPI (30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions); 9 authorised institutions were in Togo at 31 July 2026.
